problem: The new AanZET radar blog entered the public sitemap but introduced Dutch strings that were absent from the mandatory static English translation cache, causing Netlify production builds to fail closed.
root_cause: Content execution added a new public route without adding its deterministic English cache patch in the same candidate.
prevention: Every newly public sitemap route must carry complete static English cache coverage in the same lineage.
Never disable STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE to make production green.
Content automation must validate the localized-route cache before merge/promotion.

invariants: new public route has deterministic English cache
production remains fail-closed on missing translations
